subject.title: fix(outbound): clear recoveryState on connect-phase errors so drain can retry (#100979)

question: Should this shared connect-phase cleanup be the canonical fix path for the linked Discord full-outage message-loss issue, or should maintainers wait for the Discord-specific reconciliation path?
rationale: Both approaches target the same message-loss issue, but this PR changes shared queue recovery semantics while the competing path changes Discord adapter reconciliation; the choice affects duplicate-send safety and follow-up scope.

options.title: Land shared cleanup
options.body: Accept this narrow shared fix for provable pre-dispatch failures and keep Discord crash/idempotency reconciliation as follow-up work.

options.title: Prefer Discord reconciliation
options.body: Pause this PR and use a Discord-specific `reconcileUnknownSend` implementation if maintainers want provider-owned platform evidence before replay.

options.title: Require live outage proof first
options.body: Keep the branch open until a redacted Discord or Gateway outage/reconnect transcript proves one queued delivery and no duplicate sends on the exact head.

recommendation.title: Land shared cleanup
recommendation.body: Accept this narrow shared fix for provable pre-dispatch failures and keep Discord crash/idempotency reconciliation as follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans the shared recovery guard, Discord delivery behavior, and the recent outbound recovery rewrite he merged and proved.
